title: Pure Tindangle
summary: Tindangle cards only, with Subterror Behemoth Fiendess, generic Fiend Links, and staples. Tindangles are DARK Fiend Flip monsters that summon themselves face-down, recur from the GY whenever a monster is Set, and climb into Tindangle Acute Cerberus.

summary.title: Starters
points: Tindangle Jhrelth discards a card to Special Summon itself in face-down Defense Position while either searching a Flip monster or sending a Tindangle card from the Deck to the GY.
Tindangle Intruder searches any Tindangle card when flipped face-up, and revives itself from the GY face-down whenever a monster is Normal or Special Summoned to your field face-down.
Tindangle Dholes revives a different Tindangle from the GY face-down whenever it is sent from the hand or Deck to the GY, and mills a Spell or Trap when flipped.

summary.title: Opening: Tindangle Jhrelth + Any Discard
steps: Activate Tindangle Jhrelth in the hand by discarding a card, sending Tindangle Intruder or Tindangle Dholes from the Deck to the GY, and Special Summoning Jhrelth face-down.
Because Jhrelth was Special Summoned face-down, Tindangle Intruder in the GY immediately revives itself in face-down Defense Position, while a milled Dholes revives another Tindangle face-down.

Special Summon Tindangle Base Gardna from the hand while you control a face-down monster, or flip your monsters with Stairs of Mail to Link Summon Subterror Behemoth Fiendess or Tindangle Acute Cerberus.

summary.title: Tindangle Trinity & Base Gardna
summary.text: Tindangle Acute Cerberus needs three different Tindangle monsters—including Tindangle Base Gardna—in the GY to gain its 3000 base ATK. Tindangle Trinity bridges both pieces: when flipped, it Special Summons Base Gardna directly from the Deck, and when used as Link Material for Acute Cerberus, it searches Gergonne's End and mills a Spell or Trap such as Tindangle Delaunay.

summary.title: Bosses & Flip Control
points: Tindangle Acute Cerberus (Link-3 from 3 Tindangles) gains 3000 ATK with Base Gardna and two other Tindangle names in the GY, gains 500 ATK per Tindangle it points to, and spawns a Tindangle Token at the end of the Battle Phase in which it attacked.

Tindangle Hound flips to turn another monster face-down and gain 1000 ATK per face-down monster on the field; Tindangle Angel flips to summon a Flip monster face-down from the hand or GY and end the opponent's Battle Phase; Tindangle Protector flips up to three face-down monsters face-up to search that many Tindangle cards.

Subterror Behemoth Fiendess mills Flip monsters to summon monsters from the hand face-down, while A Bao A Qu, the Lightless Shadow, Beat Cop from the Underworld, and Dispatchparazzi provide generic Fiend Link utility.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Stairs of Mail discards a Tindangle card (setting off Dholes or loading Intruder) to flip one of your monsters face-up or face-down, and can repeat for each different card name discarded that turn.

Gergonne's End equips to Tindangle Acute Cerberus as a Trap to make it untargetable and indestructible; once all three zones Cerberus points to have monsters, you can destroy Gergonne's End and those three monsters to deal 3000 burn damage.

Euler's Circuit stops opponent's monsters from attacking while you control 3 or more Tindangles, and Nagel's Protection shields Tindangles in the Main Monster Zones from destruction while doubling the first battle damage they inflict each turn.

Tindangle Delaunay destroys an attacking monster to summon Acute Cerberus when three Tindangles are in the GY, or banishes itself from the GY when you control no monsters in the Main Monster Zone to revive three different Tindangles face-down.
